name: Kichiku no Sato ~Inran Gibo to Yandere Imouto~
original_name: 鬼畜の里～淫乱義母とヤンデレ妹～
source:
Main character returns home for the first time in 10 years after death of his autocratic father. He is welcomed by his widowed stepmother and stepsister. Girls are afraid to be thrown away, so they offer their bodies to protagonist.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
